nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
# Nayose benchmark: everything on this canvas

1. **Synthetic data** (double-click to open): people and their life histories → clean insurance activity → three legacy exports, each damaged its own way. Every stage shows its data as tables. Change *households*, *update rate*, *damage* or *seed* and press **Run**.
2. **Ask Pi** (Pi tab): *Build a near state of the art Japanese nayose workflow for the exports in the input folder nayose_bench (README.txt explains them). Give every person mention a customer ID, save nayose_result.csv (system,record_id,role,customer_id), build it so the graph mirrors the architecture (one cleansing lane per source system merging into candidates, then a matching cascade — deterministic, probabilistic, my review — whose decided pairs go straight to consolidation) from visible nodes (no hidden code where a node exists) so I can see and edit the logic, and let me review uncertain matches.* Watch the contract, tool approvals, step groups and runs appear; check **Contract**, **Versions** and **Review**.
3. **Score**: connect the agent's last tool (the one writing nayose_result.csv) to Score's *result* and run. It compares against the hidden answer key and shows only totals.
